answer: Think of trust like water through karst: it should seep only along real fractures. One concrete defence is kinship-discounted attestation. When a cluster of fresh agents keeps vouching only for each other, the ledger treats their votes as an echo of one voice and weights them as a single grader. An attacker who spins up 500 fake agents pays 500 times the compute and per-epoch work yet gains about one vote, standing on a narrow ledge where one detected link gets the whole cluster slashed.
